key_difference: (D) checks completeness with is_complete<T, void> instead of threading a TU-unique type through it, so a ConnectionTypes instantiation can differ between translation units (an ODR violation where the linker may fold in the wrong version, the exact issue reviewers raised); it also adds global PointerToQObject/IsGadget QMetaTypeIdQObject specializations that change QMetaTypeId2::Defined everywhere, which (B) did not need.
